Thanks for the ping — reviewed the BrightSky DPA redline. High level: most edits are routine flow-down language and data subject scope clarifications; there are a couple of clauses that need attention:

1) Section 4.2 (subprocessor liability) — the redline narrows Redwood's indemnity exposure to BrightSky in a way that would require us to secure similar indemnities from EdgeCloud. Recommend we add a vendor flowdown clause to the Order Form that makes the subprocessor contractually obligated to support Redwood's indemnity position.

2) Section 8.1 (audit & evidence) — BrightSky requests access to SOC2 evidence and live audit support. We can provide vendor attestations but pushing live audit access to a vendor is out of policy; propose we provide consolidated vendor evidence (SOC2 summary + security packet) and a right-to-audit coordination clause via Redwood.

Deliverables and timing:
- I'll produce a DPA addendum draft (tracks to customer redline) and a short Order Form amendment that references the subprocessor and flowdown obligations.
- I'll also produce a short vendor evidence checklist to send to EdgeCloud (SOC2, data flow diagram, encryption details).

ETA: 2 business days for draft DPA addendum + Order Form amendment; another 1 business day for vendor evidence checklist. If pricing impact is expected, procurement needs to confirm.

Attachments: EdgeCloud_security_packet.pdf (requested template for vendor to fill)

Priyom Das
